body:
Step 5 of docs/ios-port-design.md. Distribution and updates on iOS: TestFlight, then possibly the
App Store (review, privacy labels, the self-hosted-server model explained to reviewers). The
update-required screen and the server's /app-version download_url link to the store on iOS; the
server keeps serving the APK for Android. Blocked until the iOS shell runs.
title: iPhone port step 5: distribution and updates on iOS
